June 6, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Glenn Russell Dubin decreased its stake in Voya Finl Inc (Call) (VOYA) by 16.62% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Highbridge Capital Management Llc sold 33,886 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.21% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Glenn Russell Dubin held 170,000 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.59M, down from 203,886 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Highbridge Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Voya Finl Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $8.90 billion market cap company.
